content:
Kris Jenner apparently wants to be just like Mona Lisa, but not in the way you might think.

More than a year after she confirmed she underwent a second facelift, the 71-year-old reality TV star is taking her makeover journey below the belt.

On Thursday’s episode of “The Kardashians,” the mom of six shared she’s planning to undergo a “Mona Lisa treatment” on her vagina.

Jenner explained to her longtime friend, Shelli Azoff, that it’s pretty much a “laser in your vagina [that] makes it really perfect and cute and other lovely things.”

Jenner noted it was not her first time getting the operation.

After Azoff likened the procedure to a “fountain of youth,” Jenner teased, “It’s great. Live a little, for God’s sake.”

The Cleveland Clinic explains that the minimally invasive treatment “works by repairing your vaginal tissue,” and can help “treat symptoms of vaginal atrophy like vaginal dryness and painful sex.”

The laser beams used in the procedure “destroy vaginal tissue and stimulate your vaginal tissue to generate new blood vessels and produce more collagen and elastin,” essentially helping the vagina regenerate itself, the medical center notes.

Jenner went viral last year after debuting her face lift. She opened up about her decision to get the surgery in an interview with Vogue Arabia in August 2025.

“I decided to do this facelift because I want to be the best version of myself, and that makes me happy,” she told the publication. “Just because you get older, it doesn’t mean you should give up on yourself. If you feel comfortable in your skin and you want to age gracefully—meaning you don’t want to do anything—then don’t do anything.”

Jenner added, “But for me, this is aging gracefully. It’s my version.”

New episodes of “The Kardashians” air Thursdays on Hulu.
